project.name: COS360 Frontend
project.description: School management system frontend with multi-tenant support

directory_structure.src/api: API layer - axios client, endpoints organized by feature
directory_structure.src/api/hooks: React Query hooks for data fetching/mutations
directory_structure.src/store: Note: No store directory, using lib/authStore.ts instead

main_sections: masters (academic years, classes/sections, subjects, holidays, parents, transport)
fee (categories, types, terms, mappings, receipts, transactions, refunds, reports)
expense (transactions, categories, types, departments, approvals, reports, settings)
transport (vehicles, routes, stops, trips, student assignments)

authStore.purpose: Authentication, user, role, permissions, student selection

state_management.server_state: TanStack React Query for all API data
state_management.form_state: React Hook Form with Zod validation

interceptors.request: Adds auth token, tenant header (cschema), student context headers
interceptors.response: Auto token refresh on 401, logout on refresh failure

api_integration.multi_tenant: Tenant extracted from subdomain or config.tenant.defaultTenant
api_integration.student_context: X-Student-ID, X-Academic-Year-ID, X-Class-ID headers for parent users

api_structure.example: Staff attendance: hooks in api/hooks/staff/attendance.ts, endpoints in api/staff/attendance.ts

api_integration.note: Dual hook stacks exist for some features (legacy /masters paths vs new paths)

authentication.permissions: Permission map (resource -> actions[]) from login response
authentication.roles: Student, Parent, Staff, Admin, Super Admin
authentication.parent_context: Parents can switch between their children's student contexts

ui_system.component_library: Also uses Ant Design for complex components (Select, DatePicker)
ui_system.styling_approach: Tailwind utility classes + CSS variables for theming
ui_system.theme_support: Dark/light mode via CSS classes and localStorage

students.admission: Multi-step form with academic, personal, address, parent info

staff.attendance: Staff attendance tracking (dual API paths: /staff/attendance and /masters/staff/attendance)

fee.structure: Categories, Types, Terms with hierarchical organization

data_flow_example.pattern: Component -> React Query Hook -> API Helper -> CAxios -> Backend
key_points: React Query manages cache with feature-specific keys
Two parallel hook stacks (new /staff/* vs legacy /masters/*)

common_patterns.data_fetching: Use React Query hooks from src/api/hooks
common_patterns.form_handling: React Hook Form + Zod schema validation
common_patterns.dropdowns: Use dropdown-system components for entity selection
common_patterns.error_handling: Try-catch in API helpers, toast notifications in hooks
common_patterns.optimistic_updates: Handled via React Query mutation callbacks

conventions.naming: camelCase for variables/functions, PascalCase for components/types
conventions.file_naming: PascalCase for components (.tsx), camelCase for utilities (.ts)
conventions.types: Separate type files in src/types, interface/type exports
conventions.route_files: Underscore prefix for layouts (_app, _auth), no prefix for pages

notes.multi_tenant: Tenant is determined by subdomain or defaults to test_tenant
notes.dual_apis: Some features have both /masters/* and feature-specific paths
notes.parent_features: Parents select which child to view data for
notes.testing: Vitest configured, some dropdown tests in __tests__ directories

quick_reference.add_new_route: Create file in src/routes, TanStack Router auto-generates route tree
quick_reference.add_api_endpoint: 1) Add function to src/api/[feature].ts, 2) Create React Query hook in src/api/hooks/[feature].ts
quick_reference.add_ui_component: Use shadcn CLI or manually add to src/components/ui
quick_reference.create_form: Use React Hook Form + Zod, see existing forms in components
quick_reference.add_dropdown: Use dropdown-system or create InfiniteScrollDropdown instance
quick_reference.debug_api: Check CAxios interceptors, logger.debug calls in src/lib/config.ts
